description: Implementation of the PlaybackService class managing media playback sessions, shared memory buffers, and related services within the Rialto media server.

classes.name: PlaybackService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing media playback sessions, shared memory buffers, and associated media and audio services within the Rialto server.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Activates the playback service, creates shared memory buffer, and sets the service state to active.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Deactivates the playback service, clears media pipelines and web audio players, and resets shared memory buffer.

methods.name: setMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent playbacks allowed.

methods.name: setMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent Web Audio players allowed.

methods.name: setClientDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the client display name environment variable if provided.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the file descriptor and size of the shared memory buffer if available.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the service is currently active.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playbacks configured.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players configured.

methods.name: getShmBuffer
methods.description: Returns the current shared memory buffer object.

methods.name: getMediaPipelineService
methods.description: Provides access to the media pipeline service.

methods.name: getWebAudioPlayerService
methods.description: Provides access to the Web Audio player service.
